notes.title: Localization & new sub-level - Backrooms: Lost Place
notes.content:
[h1]Localization & new sub-level[/h1]
[b]Update 0.0.2[/b]

[h3]Updates:[/h3]

[list]
[*] The "Start" button now launches the most recent level instead of always starting from Level 1.
[*] [b]Added localization support for multiple languages.[/b]
[*] Redesigned the settings menu with a new layout.
[*] Introduced an option to enable or disable vertical synchronization.
[*] Added a sensitivity adjustment settings.
[*] [b]Released new sub-level of Level 0 “Red Light”.[/b]
[*] Moved canisters on Level 4 further into the corridor for better visibility.
[*] Implemented pop-ups with helpful tips.
[*] Added additional indicators to guide players to the exit on Level 0.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where the mouse button selection displayed three words instead of three letters in the interface.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could get stuck on Level 4.
[*] Fixed a bug where the monster on Level 3 disappeared upon death.
[*] Corrected visual glitches on Level 3 (generator area).
[*] Fixed the double-click requirement to press buttons in the menu.
[/list]
And other minor bugs that I probably forgot to mention..
